verdict.rationale: Digits' developer docs say the Connect API provides a complete OpenAPI 3.0 specification covering endpoints, parameters, response schemas and auth, published at https://developer.digits.com/openapi, with OpenAPI Generator codegen documented and the spec also highlighted on the API marketing page. The probe's 404s were only at guessed paths (/openapi.json, /swagger.json, etc.), not at the documented /openapi URL, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation that the documented /openapi URL serves a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The spec is available at: https://developer.digits.com/openapi
The Digits Connect API provides a complete OpenAPI 3.0 specification that describes all available endpoints, request parameters, response schemas, and authentication requirements.
